cohort: The participants were women who underwent Cesarean Deliveries at a university-affiliated hospital between November 2008 and June 2016.
finding: Urgent surgery, general anesthesia, and higher surgeon experience were independent risk factors for major blood loss underestimation, while any previous CD decreased this risk; conversely, any previous CD and intra-abdominal adhesions were independent risk factors for major blood loss overestimation, while urgent CD decreased this risk.
mod_finding: Urgent surgery (a type of Cesarean Delivery) and any previous Cesarean Delivery were found to be independent risk factors influencing major blood loss underestimation and overestimation during Cesarean Deliveries.
